scope: FrameTrace large forensic GUI inventory HTML prototype and SQLite-backed inventory query contract

findings.summary: HTML prototype exposed size-desc sorting before the Rust SQLite query layer supported it.
findings.fix: Added size-desc to inventory_order_by and extended inventory_sort_contract_is_explicit_and_stable.

verification: Chrome headless visual QA for 10k rows, focus mode, bulk preview, and edge/regression behaviors
residual_risks: The HTML prototype still uses deterministic in-memory mock records for interaction proof; production large-case browsing must use the SQLite-backed adapter before WinUI claims.
CPU target is measured but not enforced by the existing performance QA contract.
